slug: 2025-06-23 Benin shares its X-Road-inspired DPI interoperability experience in peer learning webinar

facts.fact: ASIN speakers told a CDPI peer-learning webinar that Benin's UXP interoperability platform, operational since the programme began, enables secure data exchange across government and private entities.
The ASIN speakers said more than 1,500 services are integrated and more than 55 institutions, including banks, telecoms and insurers, are connected to the platform.
The ASIN speakers said over 70 million data exchange transactions have been completed to date.

note: As_of is the webinar article's published date; the figures are 'to date' as spoken.
